reference: Native source decode and native color interpretation, fit into the declared canvas at source time0. This preserves platform-decoded appearance, not an assertion about intended appearance of untagged media.
outputPolicy: Core Image renders into sRGB; BGRA pool tagged709 primaries/sRGB transfer/709 matrix, H2644Mbps baseline and explicit40Mbps comparison. Original source tags/bytes are never rewritten. Rotation fixture is a separately hashed metadata-only derivative of an already tagged synthetic input.
selectionPolicy: Fixed5x5 normalized lattice at0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9 plus synthetic red/green landmarks; chosen before roundtrip. Report whole-frame differences as well, without dropping edge/text pixels.
